evidence.reason: qemu_command interpolates the resolved run directory directly into QEMU -drive option values without doubling embedded commas. QEMU treats commas as option separators, so a state path such as `probe,local` produces malformed drive arguments (or misparsed options). The supplied function validates only port, RAM, and vCPU count, so there is no local rejection or escaping of comma-containing paths. This is an ordinary correctness defect in existing QEMU command construction.
